conservation.condition_narrative: There are smudges in the media. The top and bottom edges of the sheet are irregular. The media has a slight sheen and significant smudging. There is a partial watermark on the right edge "[partially obscured] / Bond." There is abrasion at the corners. The work is complete. The top and bottom edges are irregular. The support and media are secure. There is very slight discoloration at the edges. The surface is clean except for media smudging. There are half-circle handling creases in the center, left, and lower right edges. There is a slight upward curl in the top right. No previous repairs are visible.
conservation.technical_description:
**Support:** The support is a smooth medium-weight watermarked cream colored wove paper with straight and irregular edges. 
 
 
 
**Design Layers:** Hand-applied graphite. 
 
 
 
**Surface Coating:** None.

materials.content:

description: Simple line drawing, no shading. Drawing shows a canyon, steep cliff on the right side of the paper in the foreground, large hill in the background on the left. A strip of sky dotted with clouds is visible in the background. Small bumps and dots decorate the canyon.
